name: MCB 4215
title: Fundamentals of Light Microscopy and Digital Imaging
description: The principles behind a wide range of microscopy techniques, including epifluorescence, confocal, Total Internal Reflectance Microscopy (TIRFM), and super-resolution and expansion microscopy.
requirement_description: MCB 2210 or 2215. Recommended preparation: MCB 2225; experience with fluorescence microscopy gained through independent study in a biological sciences laboratory. Not open for credit to students who have passed MCB 3895 when offered as "Fundamentals of Light Microscopy and Digital Imaging."
